presentation.label: TRACK NAMES
presentation.summary: The Internal Mixer shows each track's name instead of TRK1..TRK16, with the track number above each fader.
presentation.overview: Track Names draws each track's name from SETUP > RENAME (its first 5 characters) in place of the mixer's TRK labels, and the track number in an inverted box at the top left of each fader. The names live in the pattern's kit, so each pattern has its own. The mod only draws; it saves nothing.
highlights: Names on the Internal Mixer, first 5 characters
Per pattern, from the stock names
usage: Name tracks short in SETUP > RENAME (KICK, SNARE, BASS), then open FUNC + MOD, pages 2/5 and 3/5.

access.location: FUNC + MOD, Internal Mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5
steps: Name a track: FUNC + FLTR (SETUP), RENAME at the end of the TRACK section, YES.
Open FUNC + MOD and press it again until Internal Mixer (2/5) or (3/5).

limitations: Only the Internal Mixer pages show names.
The mixer shows at most 5 characters of a name.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

hardware.summary: crisp909 (the author) built the package with the pinned toolchain in Docker (source commit bc32ae2, package sha256 cc908de8), built the image on elekloader.github.io with core 1.0 and ran it on a Digitakt II, OS 1.17. Reported: the Internal Mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5 show the track names (first 5 characters) and the numbered badges; each pattern shows its own names with PERFORM KIT off; the names come back after SAVE PROJECT and a reload; the other pages are unchanged; pop-ups such as pattern select stay on top, names clipped at their edge.
limitations: PERFORM KIT on was not tested.
Faint row lines beside pop-ups are the OLED's own crosstalk, seen with the stock OS too.
